feeding_claim.verbatim: We also offer pure Angus beef from cows who are pasture raised, hormone free and locally grown.

notes: Raises animals at Queen Creek and Snowflake, AZ and Glendale, UT. Homepage title says grass-fed but body text only says pasture raised with plenty of green grass; Wagyu feeding not described, so category kept cautious at pastured. Pigs on pasture with chickens. 'Organically fed' claim with no certification. Pickup at the Mesa address; no delivery or shipping named. Contact by form only.
